The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] used '''submersible probe droids''' on [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] such as [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. One such [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was severely damaged on Manaan, and captured by the local [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] before the Republic could recover it. The Republic sent [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] to infiltrate the Sith base in [[Ahto City/Legends|Ahto City]] to get the data module from the damaged droid.<ref name="Kotor">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]</ref>
